blocks.text: TDCSS Addiction Services, in partnership with Northern Health/Mental Health, is providing Addictions Day Treatment for adults in Terrace. The Day Treatment group currently meets twice a week (Tuesdays and Fridays) at the Elks Hall, from 9:00 AM to 2:30 PM. Snacks and a lunch are served. The full program lasts 8 weeks and covers such subjects as safety planning, relapse prevention, communication and healthy lifestyle choices. Intakes are continuous and are by referral through TDCSS Addiction Services or Terrace Mental Health
